quotes.text: Terminate work on the LEAP Lunar Rover Mission (LRM)

CSA (Canadian Space Agency) Rover is designed to traverse the surface of the Moon to access, explore, and discover remote South Pole areas of interest, including the ability to survive multiple lunar nights (one lunar night is approximately 14 Earth days) and explore permanently shadowed regions for a short duration.
